purpose: Authoritative registry for deciding what may move from this template into a downstream coding-agent repository.

downstream_placeholders.rule: Copy placeholders only, then replace or remove them with downstream-specific content. Do not copy template AGENTS.md files.

classes.template-only: Template history, identity, release, and maintenance context. Never copy.
classes.selective: A reusable implementation may be copied only when the downstream repository opts in and adapts names, paths, providers, and evidence commands.
classes.placeholder-only: Only the listed empty-content placeholder may be installed; current template content is not downstream content.
classes.downstream-owned: Create and maintain independently in the downstream repository.
classes.template-only-or-adapt: Reference material that requires a manual rewrite for downstream identity and policy; never overwrite wholesale.
classes.template-example: Minimal executable example used to bootstrap a downstream Agent; copy only as a renamed, adapted scaffold, never unchanged.

repository_inventory.description: Every tracked path in this repository is covered by one of these patterns. When a specific entry below also matches, the specific entry and its adaptation rule takes precedence over the broader directory pattern.

patterns.note: Use the specific entries below for selectable skills and neutral placeholders.

Development-only Claude Code discovery adapter. Recreate skills as a relative symlink to ../.agents/skills; do not copy skills or AGENTS.md. Write downstream-scoped instructions and exclude from product payloads.
Adapt build-context and credential/development exclusions.
Reference variable names only; never copy values.
Review CI and repository-specific automation manually.
Merge downstream entries while preserving secret/generated-output exclusions.
Development-only OpenCode configuration and dependency metadata.
Template development policy; write downstream-scoped instructions instead.
Symlink to AGENTS.md; recreate downstream with ln -s, never copy.
Rewrite development scope and evidence policy for the downstream repository.
Temporary implementation plans are PR-visible development records, not downstream product content.
Rewrite identity, commands, provider matrix, and release URLs.
Rewrite installation and supported backend/provider documentation.

Generated development diagrams describing this template's sample Agent. Downstream repositories regenerate their own with the agent-evaluation-loop-design skill; never copy these as downstream product facts.
Template benchmark tasks and evidence are not downstream acceptance evidence.
Select installer and native pi container entrypoint behavior individually; exclude AGENTS.md.
Select Docker files individually and adapt Agent names, binaries, providers, and credentials.
Merge required scripts and metadata; do not overwrite product metadata.
Adopt only required development tooling declarations.
Generated template release artifacts; build downstream-specific releases instead.
Merge development dependencies intentionally; keep runtime dependencies isolated.
Select scripts individually and adapt names, paths, and provider assumptions.

Use src/hewo only as a reference scaffold; create src/<agent> and replace identity and runtime resources. Its smoke resources may probe initialization infrastructure, but must not be inherited as product behavior.
Adopt only when downstream development tooling uses TypeScript.

entries.note: Create knowledge entries for the downstream Agent; do not copy the template directory.
Secret-free E2E credential-injection cheat-sheet for this template's development machine; not downstream content.
Record downstream decisions and evidence only; do not copy template issue history.
Define downstream development workflows independently.
Registry for this template; it is not downstream development content.
Write downstream-scoped instructions instead of copying these files.

entries.initialization_rule: Phase 0 may retain only the minimum smoke capability as infrastructure evidence. Do not inherit HeWo name, identity, domain semantics, historical evidence, or product behavior; define formal identity, skills, knowledge, and workflows only after explicit Phase 1 authorization.

entries.note: Use as a reference only; rewrite product identity and commands.
Use as a reference only; downstream development policy must be reviewed.
Rewrite for the downstream product and its supported backends/providers.
Adopt only packaging behavior required by the downstream Agent.
Adopt only after reviewing backend binaries, credentials, and runtime boundaries.
Human setup and release entrypoints only; select individually and adapt calls into .agents/scripts/.

adapt_required: downstream agent name, paths and evidence commands
provider assumptions and frozen snapshot execution
entries.note: Coding-agent internal tooling, moved from scripts/ without removing functionality. Select implementation files individually; exclude AGENTS.md and write downstream-scoped instructions instead.
Template benchmark tasks and evidence are not downstream acceptance evidence.
Review CI and issue automation manually; do not copy template assumptions wholesale.
Machine-agnostic probe/render skill; each machine's non-probeable facts live in the downstream-owned development-machine-facts.md.
Operator-confirmed, secret-free machine facts; downstream repositories create their own and keep them device-local.

adapt_required: evaluation contract, metrics, thresholds and stop conditions
regenerated diagrams and README managed blocks
entries.note: Development-only design skill. Copy the method, then write a downstream contract and regenerate the diagrams; the committed diagrams and fixtures describe this template, not downstream products.
Fixed, provider-free test fixtures and protected self-bootstrap outcome cases. They are this template's test data, never downstream acceptance evidence.
hewo's infrastructure-smoke-only evaluation contract. A downstream Agent writes its own contract; a smoke-only contract never demonstrates a performance improvement.

adapt_required: pi version and the locally verified loader flags
downstream runtime resource layout and manifest paths
downstream development-resource directory if it is not .agents/
entries.note: Development-side component decision tree and pi capability matrix. Re-verify every flag against the downstream machine's own pi --help before relying on it.
Development record of this template's pi convergence, verified pi limits and the .agents/ collision hazard; downstream repositories record their own.

adapt_required: nothing in the file itself: it is a symlink to AGENTS.md and has no content of its own
entries.note: Symlink to AGENTS.md so Claude Code reads the same instructions the other coding agents read. Recreate it downstream with `ln -s AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md`; never copy AGENTS.md to a second file, which would let the two diverge. Excluded from every payload alongside AGENTS.md.

adapt_required: the governed set, which depends on the downstream repository's own document layout
the Contains/Excludes wording of every role block, which is per-document
the audience vocabulary if the downstream product serves a different set of readers
entries.note: The role/content separation convention and its governed set. Its executable form is .agents/scripts/check-document-roles.py; copy both or neither.
